sloka: स तु वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः ।जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।। ७.२२.५१ ।।
transliteration: sa tu vaivasvato devaiḥ saha brahmapurogamaiḥ ।jagāma tridivaṁ hṛṣṭo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ ।। 7.22.51 ।।

translations.english: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.
